title: Doctoral Scholarships
summary: Funding for doctoral students from all disciplines working on an innovative research project and admitted to a doctoral programme at a university in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Doctorates in human medicine and dentistry are excluded.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are supported except human medicine and dentistry.

institutions.notes: Must be admitted to a doctoral programme at a university.
